trigger_cases.prompt: Run our Sprint Planning session: formulate our sprint goal and size our backlog.
Help our squad groom upcoming epics using INVEST criteria and the Definition of Ready.

binary_cases.prompt: Generate a Scrum Sprint Planning contract for a checkout team with 1 sprint goal and capacity calibration.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Must include 1 singular Sprint Goal, capacity calculation, and committed backlog items.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
## 1. Singular Sprint Goal
Enable instant Apple Pay checkout for mobile users.

## 2. Capacity Calibration
- Trailing velocity: 28 pts.
- Available capacity: 22 story points.

## 3. Committed Sprint Backlog
- Story 1: Apple Pay PassKit client (8 pts)
- Story 2: Decryption token endpoint (8 pts)
- Story 3: Analytics telemetry (6 pts)
